title: EpiPersona: Persona Projection and Episode Coupling for Pluralistic Preference Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2603.28197v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pluralistic alignment is essential for adapting large language models (LLMs) to the diverse preferences of individuals and minority groups. However, existing personalized reward models often mix stable personal traits with episode-specific factors, limiting their ability to generalize across episodes. To address this challenge, we propose EpiPersona, a framework for explicit persona-episode coupling. EpiPersona first projects noisy preference feedback into a low-dimensional persona space, where similar personas are aggregated into shared discrete codewords. This process separates enduring personal characteristics from situational signals without relying on predefined preference dimensions. The inferred persona representation is then coupled with the current episode, enabling episode-aware preference prediction. Extensive experiments show that EpiPersona outperforms the baselines. translated_title: EpiPersona：面向多元偏好建模的人格投影与情境耦合
translated_abstract: 多元对齐对于使大语言模型（LLMs）适应个人及少数群体的多样化偏好至关重要。然而，现有的个性化奖励模型往往将稳定的个人特质与情境特定因素混杂在一起，限制了其在不同情境之间的泛化能力。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了EpiPersona，一个实现显式人格-情境耦合的框架。EpiPersona首先将含噪的偏好反馈投影到一个低维人格空间中，在该空间中相似的人格被聚合为共享的离散码字。这一过程在不依赖预定义偏好维度的情况下，将持久的个人特征与情境信号分离开来。随后，推断出的人格表示会与当前情境进行耦合，从而实现情境感知的偏好预测。大量实验表明，EpiPersona的表现优于基线方法，并在困难情境场景中取得了显著的性能提升。
tldr: EpiPersona通过将含噪偏好反馈投影到低维人格空间并聚合为共享离散码字，从而分离稳定的个人特质与情境信号，再将人格表示与当前情境耦合，实现情境感知的多元偏好预测。
en_tdlr: EpiPersona projects noisy preference feedback into a low-dimensional persona space with shared discrete codewords to disentangle stable personal traits from situational signals, then couples the inferred persona with the current episode to enable episode-aware pluralistic preference prediction.
